title: Miray E
content: I have been in a bad marriage and was severely depressed. I prayed every day for Jesus to take me. I was suicidal at one point and even asked someone to hire a person to shoot me while I was walking; without me knowing when or where. The request was rejected, as I knew it would be. But, I still hoped it might happen. I just wanted my life to end, although I knew it was wrong. I am Catholic and believe only Jesus can take my life. Yet, I still hoped to die. I wanted life to be over and longed for eternal peace. I was writing a poem, which is something I enjoy doing. One morning, I was sitting in my bed writing a poem. Suddenly, I felt my soul leaving my body. I floated higher into the sky. I saw angels surrounding me; singing and playing flutes. Then, I found myself in a dark sky. I was kneeling on a huge rock before a towering figure in a bright, white dress. I knew it was Jesus. I couldn’t look up at His face. Without speaking a word, I heard Him say, "It is not your time yet." Without touching me, His hand threw me backward into my body on the bed. I opened my eyes and was sad that I couldn’t stay with Him. My heart wasn’t beating, but I felt my soul in my body. My eyes were open, but I couldn’t move. Suddenly, I felt a hand pass deep into my chest, squeezing my heart three times until it started beating again. I got out of bed, called my mom at work, and told her my story. For the next few days, I felt pain in my heart from the hand pressing on it to restart its beat.

elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness, no difference
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: My hearing was normal but I could hear the sound of space, a void of nothingness
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, I heard music and saw angels surrounding me as I ascended
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I do not fear death. But, I fear dying in a harmful way, as my relatives and people back home are suffering. That always scares me. However, I wake up every day and say, 'He has a plan for me,' and I go forward with my life. There is a reason for me being back on earth. Day by day I find out why through my daily actions, whether helping animals, birds, people, or anything that needs my help. Now I think my purpose is to help in any way I can.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, My sister-in-law spoke about her mom's near-death experience in a hospital.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, The feeling of peace and joy while floating higher and higher in the sky while surrounded by angels playing flutes was definitely real.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, same feeling
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, I remember my experience very well, and the questions asked were answered honestly.
